host_build.cxx_version:
clang version 23.1.4
Target: x86_64-pc-linux-gnu
Thread model: posix
InstalledDir: /usr/bin

method: Separate instrumented fresh-process probes. Wasm setup includes engine/store/load/link/instantiate; ordinary Wasm input reading/config creation precede that timer, AOT file loading is inside it. Wasm entry includes Goose initialization and callbacks but excludes final stdout delivery. Native main is wrapped through Linux __libc_start_main via LD_PRELOAD and includes Goose initialization plus unbuffered output. Timing-file writes/teardown are outside both entry clocks. Neither interval is a pure compute kernel; no pure-startup subtraction is claimed.
